description: Installation of the 3no. air conditioning units to the side elevation of the dwellinghouse (Retrospective Planning Application)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be retained and thereafter maintained in complete accordance with the following approved plans:
PR26-049h (Site Location Plan and Block Plan)
PR26-049c (Existing Floor Plans and Roof Plan)
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020), and the London Plan (2021).

All air conditioning equipment and associated external apparatus shall be removed from the site within three months of becoming redundant, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that redundant plant and equipment do not detract from the visual amenities of the area or the appearance of the building, in accordance with Policies DMHB 11 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).
